exemplars.title: Rehearsal: Simulating Conflict to Teach Conflict Resolution
exemplars.why: The user enters a conflict as a participant, interacts with a believable simulated counterpart, and can rerun counterfactual versions to explore different conversational behavior—the most complete evidence of enactment, world response, and restart among the candidates.
exemplars.over_the_runner_up: Chosen over rid 3944 because it explicitly supports repeated counterfactual runs, demonstrating the pattern’s restart semantics as well as its role-play frame.

exemplars.title: Generative Role-Play Communication Training in Virtual Reality for Autistic Individuals: A Study on Job Coach Experiences in Vocational Training Programs
exemplars.why: Its separation between coach-authored scenario setup and trainee enactment with an LLM-powered avatar makes the transition from configuration to in-role participation unusually visible.
exemplars.over_the_runner_up: Chosen over rid 7482 because it more explicitly assigns the model a counterpart role and separates scenario authoring from the participant-facing runtime.

exemplars.title: CareerSim: Gamification Design Leveraging LLMs For Career Development Reflection
exemplars.why: Players configure an in-world identity before entry, after which attribute-conditioned career events turn their inputs into consequential choices inside the simulation rather than instructions to a tool.
exemplars.over_the_runner_up: Chosen over rid 4509 because its evidence specifies self-representation, a distinct game-entry transition, responsive scenario generation, and in-world conduct, while rid 4509 establishes only topic selection followed by dialogue.

notes: I retained the top two consensus candidates but promoted rid 7482 from fifth into the final set, displacing rid 4509 and rid 15126. Its quoted evidence covers more of the structural signature: pre-entry character configuration, an explicit frame switch when the game begins, world events conditioned on setup parameters, and participant choices within those events. The evidence should still be treated cautiously: rid 3062 alone clearly supports rerunning scenarios, none of the excerpts documents an explicit exit mechanism, and the supplied excerpts do not establish measured outcomes. Rid 3944’s setup is performed by a job coach rather than necessarily by the eventual participant, while rid 7482’s model-controlled generation is clearer from the paper framing than from the quoted figure text alone. No score adjustment exceeds 0.3.
